purpose: Anchor original B1 frozen result files through the existing Ledger interface, and measure registry correctness and overhead.

baseline.type: single-writer signed SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL log
baseline.limitation: Local log and EVM block inclusion have different trust and durability semantics.

metrics.gas: receipt gasUsed; deployment and metadata revisions reported separately
metrics.latency: client monotonic elapsed time from start of transaction submission to observing a one-confirmation receipt
metrics.throughput: successful writes divided by wall-clock span from first submission start to final receipt observation per replicate
metrics.intervals: descriptive median, p95, and replicate range; no independence claim across individual transactions

scope.reportedModelResultsSource: original B1 results/results.json and six-file evidence bundle from the supplied project
scope.resultHashEncoding: SHA-256 ABI encoding of sourceRecordId, conclusion, evidenceHash, evidenceURI, modelVersion, confidence
